note: Character-select cards. Stack at (0,0): frame/<id> -> portrait/<id> -> trim/<id> -> text (draw in-engine from this file, or use full/<id>) -> selected.png / locked.png as state overlays.

the_gambler.title: THE GAMBLER
the_gambler.tagline: WHAT HE LOST IS STILL ON THE TABLE
the_gambler.flavor: He remembers nothing but the Trail. To win back what he lost, he must face the Dealer again.
the_gambler.description_from_shiloh: A gunslinger that gambled his life away, he remembers nothing but the Trail, to gain what he lost he must face the dealer again.

the_machine.title: THE MACHINE
the_machine.flavor: Origin: unknown. Memory: damaged. Directive: reach the end of the Trail.
the_machine.description_from_shiloh: Sent from another time? Dimension? It does not have that information in its damaged systems, all its programmed to do is reach the end of the trail.

the_doctor.title: THE DOCTOR
the_doctor.tagline: THE DEALER HAS HIS TIME MACHINE
the_doctor.flavor: The Dealer holds his time machine. Until he wins it back, the loop never ends.
the_doctor.description_from_shiloh: Inspired by both Doctor Who and Doc from Back to the Future. The Dealer has the Time Machine, that's what keeps him in this never ending loop.
